text:
Leah: FYI weekly release broadcast for v4.0.0-rc1. Cutting release candidate tonight.
Leah: Code freeze begins Tue 22:00 PT. Post-freeze commits must follow the RC hotfix flow (branch `release/v4.0.0-rc1`).
Leah: Canary rollout schedule: Wed 06:30 PT start, 2h linear ramp to 100% with automated validation gates.

ReleaseBot: release/v4.0.0-rc1 created at commit def5678. Validation jobs queued: unit, integration, perf-smoke.

Diego: Quick note 3 0 - the authorization token rotation landed in main earlier. Is that safe to include? Any consumer migration windows?

Priya: Diego: Token rotation is included but feature-flagged off by default. We'll enable in canary-2 only. No migration window needed but watch auth error spikes.

Diego: Great. Also adding a short migration test: `scripts/auth/migration_check.sh` to run during canary-1.

Priya: Thx 1. Also ops will run a cache sweep after canary-3 to avoid thundering re-warms. Command: `infra/cache_sweep --scope global --parallel 6`

Oncall-Bot: Oncall assigned: Priya (Wed 05:45-11:45 PT). Slack alerting enabled for `errors>0.3%` OR `p95>350ms` sustained 5m.

Leah: Rollback criteria summary: if error rate increases >0.3% for 10m OR CPU on GPU nodes >85% for 15m, trigger rollback. Manual hold if any data-regression evals fail.

Diego: Heads-up: two dependent infra migrations are scheduled Thu; they were postponed so they won't conflict.

Priya: Can we freeze migrations to next week? We want the environment stable for RC.

Leah: Confirmed: infra migrations postponed to next maintenance window.

ReleaseBot: Reminder: to pause ramp use `releasectl pause --id v4.0.0-rc1`, to abort use `releasectl abort --id v4.0.0-rc1`.

Leah: Action items:
- Owners: add short rollback plan to your PRs (due Tue 18:00 PT)
- QA: run canary smoke checklist and post results to this thread
- Eng: no schema churn after freeze unless exempted

Diego: I'll post migration test logs to this thread and tag failures.

Priya: I'll export perf snapshots right after canary-1.

Leah: Thanks team 1. See you Wed morning for go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
